Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this — Lodestar is starting our SIG/CAIQ intake for Q3 vendors and we want to get a short intake call scheduled next week to align on artifact delivery and transfer method. Our immediate ask is: can you receive a sample archive with request/response logs (sanitized), inference telemetry (latency/token counts), and an access matrix? We'll need confirmation on:

- Preferred transfer: SFTP vs pre-signed cloud link vs secure SharePoint
- Max file size and retention in your evidence portal
- Contact for any redaction questions

Proposed windows (PDT): Mon 9–11am or Tue 2–4pm.

I've attached a quick manifest (see attachment) with the list of files we expect.

Appreciate it — Emma

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake: sample archive request & scheduling

Emma — thanks, this is clear. We can take a sample archive for review. Quick answers up front:

- Transfer: we prefer a pre-signed GCS or S3 link (short-lived) for large archives; SFTP is OK if you need an outbound push.
- Max single archive: usually 50GB in our evidence portal; for anything >50GB we ask for split archives or an rsync-friendly mechanism.
- Retention: evidence archives we ingest for SIG/CAIQ review are retained in our compliance workspace for 90 days by default; we can extend for audits if needed (we'll record retention in the intake ticket).

I can do Mon 9:30–10:00 or Tue 2:00–2:30 PDT. Which works? Also: do you need full CAIQ (complete Qs) or just SIG-lite? That will determine how many artifacts we need to pull.

I'll loop Karthik and Grace on artifact ownership.

Thanks,
Markus

--
Markus Klein
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding Lodestar's intake. Quick internal notes (no external):

- Karthik: can you own the retention/archival confirmation and the pre-signed URL parameters? Lodestar may push a ~30–60GB tar; confirm whether we request split archives or accept a single link.
- Grace: can you own the log sanitization checklist from our side (PII removal) and confirm the evidence portal path we will drop to? Also confirm whether we need an encrypted transfer (we should).

Emma asked for SIG vs CAIQ depth — Markus replied asking preference. If Lodestar wants full CAIQ, we'll need additional policy docs and policy attestations (policy owner names).

Thanks — please reply here so I can include a single response to Lodestar.

Markus
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@lodestar.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake: sample archive request & scheduling

Emma — welcome, and thanks for the manifest. Mon 9:30–10:00 PDT works for us; I've added the meeting on the calendar.

Operational notes and deliverables before the call:

1) Transfer method: pre-signed S3 link is preferred. If you need to push via SFTP, we'll provide credentials in the intake ticket (SFTP requires a brief firewall exception). Pre-signed link expiry: please set to 72 hours.

2) File expectations: we can accept a single tar up to 50GB. For 50–200GB, please split into quarterly archives (Q1,Q2 or multiple parts). Lodestar indicated Q2 logs only; the filename we expect is: lodestar_sample_logs_q2.tar.gz.

3) Required artifacts for SIG-lite intake:
   - request_response_logs/*.log (sanitized)
   - inference_metrics.csv (latency, token_count)
   - access_matrix.xlsx (mapping of service accounts + roles)
   - high-level architecture diagram (PDF)

4) Redaction: remove any customer PII and client IPs; if you need our redaction script, request it and we'll send a small tool.

5) Evidence storage: Redwood will store the archive in a restricted compliance bucket for 90 days. If Lodestar requires a different retention window for audit, tell us during the call and we'll open a policy extension request.

I uploaded a small sample manifest and an evidence-drop checklist to a temporary Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cLodestarSamples (pre-shared). Attached to this message are the manifest we referenced and an access matrix template to help with mapping.

Attachments: lodestar_sample_logs_q2.tar.gz (placeholder stub), access_matrix.xlsx (template)

See you Monday. If anything changes on your side, ping me here.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Security Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com
